_comment: TEMPLATE. Qwen2.5 pair for text rebase: A = Qwen2.5-0.5B, B = Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct (identical architecture, different post-training), which is the decoder-only analogue of the ViT-B-32 openai -> laion2b vision pair: shapes match, so the 'untransported' baseline is available.
_todo: No Qwen finetunes ship with this repo. Produce them first with `python -m merge_and_rebase.finetune.train_text --text-config <your config>` (backbone.model_name_or_path: Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B, strategy.name: full or peft_lora, output.extract_heads: true), then fill tuned_ckpts / source_task_heads / target_task_heads below.
_cross_size_note: For a cross-size run (0.5B -> 1.5B: 24 vs 28 layers, hidden 896 vs 1536) just swap target_model_name_or_path. The untransported baseline disables itself and the report falls back to target_zeroshot.
